newsitem.title: UK: Blue Circle up amid recovery hopes.
newsitem.headline: Blue Circle up amid recovery hopes.

text.p: Shares in Blue Circle Plc were the second biggest gainers in percentage terms in the FTSE 100 index by early afternoon on Friday, rebounding from recent sharp declines amid hopes for improved trading in 1997, analysts and dealers said.
Blue Circle was up 11-1/2p or 3.2 percent at 368-1/2 by 1350 GMT, only bettered by the 6.1 percent rise in Hanson Plc.
Analyst Jonathan Timms at Charterhouse Tilney pointed out that Blue Circle had underperformed other building material stocks such as Caradon Plc and BPB Plc in recent weeks and was due a bounce.

"A bit of catch-up was overdue," Timms said. "Last year was pretty terrible but we always knew it was going to be bad. The political outlook makes the outlook for the first part of this year a bit uncertain but the economy is improving and the building sector should follow on from that."
Others in the sector were also mostly higher with Redland Plc up 2p at 355-1/2 and RMC Group Plc up 6-1/2p at 997-1/2.
